text:
Please do not install the 1.1.96 update from the prompt (tap Later): on this version (1.1.95) it fails. These steps may work instead:
1. Settings > Map: off.
2. Set the range to 1.
3. Unplug the radar for 10 seconds and plug it in.
4. Settings > System > Check for update, then Install.
If this does not work, unplug for 10 seconds, plug in, and stay on 1.1.95. I am looking into a fix.
